name: TCP UART
description: This component allows ESPHome to use a TCP connection as a [UART bus](https://esphome.io/components/uart/). Bytes received on the socket can be read like UART data, and bytes written to the UART are sent to the socket. Any component that has a `uart_id` option can use it.

config_entries.label: Host
config_entries.description: The host to connect to. An IPv4 address or a hostname. IPv6 is not supported. This option cannot be used when `role` is `server`.

config_entries.label: Port
config_entries.description: When `role` is `client`, the TCP port to connect to. When `role` is `server`, the TCP port to listen on.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID used for code generation. Use this ID as `uart_id` in other components.

config_entries.label: Allowed Ips
config_entries.description: IPv4 addresses that may connect. A plain address is one host. A network is written in CIDR form, for example `192.0.2.0/24`. At most 255 entries. If the option is omitted, every address may connect. A rejected client is closed immediately and logged as a warning at most once every 5 seconds; an IPv6 client is rejected unless it carries an IPv4 mapped address, as on a dual stack network. This option cannot be used when `role` is `client`.

config_entries.label: Baud Rate
config_entries.description: The baud rate reported to consuming components. The socket itself has no clock; components such as `modbus` read this value for their frame timing. Defaults to `9600`.

config_entries.label: Data Bits
config_entries.description: The number of data bits reported to consuming components. Defaults to `8`.

config_entries.label: Parity
config_entries.description: The parity reported to consuming components. One of `NONE`, `EVEN`, `ODD`. Defaults to `NONE`.

config_entries.label: Reconnect Interval
config_entries.description: The time to wait before connecting again after a failed or closed connection. An unanswered connection attempt is given up after `reconnect_interval` or 10 seconds, whichever is longer. For a server, this is the wait after a failed listen or accept; a new client is accepted as soon as the current one disconnects. Defaults to `5s`.

config_entries.label: Stop Bits
config_entries.description: The number of stop bits reported to consuming components. One of `1`, `2`. Defaults to `1`.
